event: With Miriam targeted, Vesper orders Protocol-Alt: Miriam to corner F, Dayo interposes.
Solenne sees the plan assumed Dayo; Miriam has only 268 HP.
Miriam crosses twelve meters to the corner F pillar alcove and plants.
Dayo Shield Rushes diagonally to cut between the Sentinel and Miriam.
Nadia's Chaos Grenade rolls Fear; the Sentinel hesitates six seconds.
Tomás fires two arrows into the shoulder joints to slow Phase 3 speed.
Vesper casts Reinforcement on Miriam's armor.
Vesper says "Set" and returns to the south pillar.
Shaking off Fear, the Sentinel locks back onto Miriam; Dayo stands between.
The Sentinel charges, smashing straight through a pillar toward corner F.
Dayo Shield Rushes its leading leg and breaks the charge, sliding three meters.
Dayo catches a Phase 3 jaw strike on her buckler; HP falls to 289.
Miriam's Mending Touch lands through a pillar gap two seconds later.
The Sentinel turns back toward Miriam; the fight becomes interception.
Dayo beats it to the south gap with a second Shield Rush.
The Sentinel circles to the pillar gap at position C.
Dayo plants Iron Stance in the gap and takes a full jaw slam without moving.
Solenne's Arcane Bolt snaps its head aside; Dayo releases and moves on.
Tomás's two arrows to the right shoulder cut its charge to ninety percent speed.
The boss falls to fifteen percent; Dayo falls to 70 HP with no Last Stand.
Dayo moves now with an awareness of what she has left.
The Sentinel breaks a southeast gap; Dayo is eight meters out of position.
Dayo activates Anchor fully and deliberately on all five bonds at once.
Through the Conductor Solenne feels the Anchor reach each of the five.
Solenne feels Dayo sense each of them: her steadiness, Miriam, Vesper, Tomás.
Through the Anchor Dayo feels that Nadia is frightened Dayo will die.
Dayo does not flinch and charges to close the gap.
One second before contact, all six Status Windows flicker in sync.
Resonance Surge: authentic; all six gain +1 RES and full HP/MP.
Surge Lock freezes the Sentinel mid-lunge.
The Tower's light warms past amber; Solenne senses the Tower watching.
The Conductor's deep channel opens and Solenne hears all Aspects as a chord.
For two seconds she senses Six of Six, but RES 19 falls short of 20.
The perception fades; Dayo stands frozen mid-charge at 467 of 467 HP.
With three seconds left, Solenne tells Tomás to take the jaw joint when it opens.
Tomás says he sees it; Nadia says she is ready with the last Chaos Grenade.
Solenne raises her staff, with no time for Ley Conduit.
Surge Lock ends; the Sentinel resumes at eight percent HP.
Dayo intercepts at full HP and staggers it; its charge toward Miriam fails.
Solenne says now; Nadia's grenade puts the Sentinel to Sleep.
Tomás's arrow opens a two-centimeter gap at the jaw-base joint.
Solenne fires a full Arcane Bolt into the gap at the same instant, uncalled.
The bolt burns through the thin magic layer and the Ironjaw Sentinel dies.
Ironjaw defeated in 9:47, all standing: 3,125 XP, Sentinel's Fang, First Boss Coat.
The chamber quiets; the Sentinel's armor hisses as it cools.
Dayo, at full HP, lowers her buckler and does not add a fifth tally mark.
Miriam leaves corner F and puts a hand on Dayo's shoulder.
Dayo looks at Nadia for one second and does not tell her what she felt.
Party Record logs the Surge and confirms Dayo's full five-bond Anchor.
Vesper kneels at the jaw and takes the Sentinel's Fang.
The First Boss Coat materializes; Dayo picks it up and it fits.
Class Selection: Pending; each one's current class is confirmed Advanced, no other options.
Solenne writes Almost on her staff beneath designed.
The six drift together in the aftermath.
Solenne tells them they are very close to something; she'll explain later.
Nobody presses her; Dayo says, "Okay."
The light returns to amber and an exit portal opens at the far wall.
Solenne looks at the word Almost and at the five others.
